page: Google Cloud Platform c2-standard-4 is a compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 Intel Xeon processors running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The server features 2 physical cores with 2 hyperthreads per core, presenting 4 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) to the operating system. Hardware capabilities include instruction set extensions such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, BMI2, FMA, and ADX. Cache specifications include 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 24 MB L3 cache. System memory totals 16.0 GB, allocating 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local NVMe SSD storage or discrete GPU accelerators are included with this server configuration.

Benchmark testing highlights solid single-threaded execution alongside constrained multi-threaded scaling. Single-core performance achieves average scores across multiple evaluations, including a stress-ng score of 1572.39, a Geekbench single-core score of 1309.0, and a gzip compression rate of 26.8 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput falls in the lower benchmark percentile ranges, reflected in a stress-ng multi-core result of 4147.67, a Geekbench multi-core score of 2855.0, and a Passmark CPU score of 4761.94. Uncached memory bandwidth measures 28.26 GB/sec for reads and 24.11 GB/sec for writes, contributing to lower operational throughput in database operations (1545.89 Passmark DB score) and Redis SET tasks (4.1 million ops/sec). Small language model inference using a 135M model reaches 267.33 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 74.92 tokens/sec for text generation.

The dedicated vCPU allocation and reliable single-threaded CPU clock speeds provide predictable runtime behavior for single-threaded or low-concurrency execution profiles. However, the small physical core footprint of 2 cores and moderate memory bandwidth restrict performance under parallel multi-core workloads or high-concurrency database queries. Lacking bundled local SSD storage, persistent block storage must be attached externally over the network. The c2-standard-4 profile delivers balanced efficiency for lightweight batch processing, single-threaded compile jobs, entry-level web serving, and small-scale automation scripts where high per-core single-threaded output is prioritized over parallel processing density.
description: Google Cloud Platform c2-standard-4 is a compute-optimized x86_64 instance featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs from 2 physical Intel Xeon cores running at 3.1 GHz, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory. It incorporates AVX-512 instruction extensions and a 24 MB L3 cache, but includes no local SSD storage or discrete GPUs. Benchmark results demonstrate reliable average single-core CPU performance, achieving a stress-ng score of 1572.39 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1309.0. However, multi-core throughput and memory bandwidth fall in lower benchmark percentiles due to the 2-core hardware physical footprint. Static web serving throughput reaches 4.11 GB/sec, while Redis execution completes 4.1 million SET operations per second. The server provides strong per-core single-thread efficiency, making it well-suited for lightweight batch utilities, single-threaded software compilation, small-scale web applications, and basic background task workers.
